_about: Export targets for tools/builds.py (and tools/export.sh, which calls it). One entry per platform: the preset name in export_presets.cfg, the file Godot writes into build/<platform>/, and the template files it needs in ~/.local/share/godot/export_templates/<godot version>/. 'local' is the platform tools/play.sh runs on this machine. A change under a 'watch_ignore' folder or to a 'watch_ignore_files' file never needs a rebuild (none of them go into the export).

linux.label: Linux (x86_64)
linux.how_to_run: Unzip, then double-click eightysix.x86_64 (or run ./eightysix.x86_64). Keep eightysix.pck beside it.

windows.label: Windows (x86_64)
windows.how_to_run: Unzip, then run eightysix.exe. Keep eightysix.pck beside it. The game is not signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn: More info, then Run anyway.

macos.label: macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon)
macos.how_to_run: Unzip and move Eighty Six.app to Applications. The game is not notarised by Apple, so the first time: right-click the app, Open, then Open again (or System Settings, Privacy & Security, Open Anyway).
